season.name: Spring
season.line: New growth is most exposed when it is youngest.

movement.name: The Sowing
movement.line: Plant before you can see the harvest.

x: And God planted a garden eastward in Edem, and placed there the man whom he had formed.

And God made to spring up also out of the earth every tree beautiful to the eye and good for food, and the tree of life in the midst of the garden, and the tree of learning the knowledge of good and evil.

days.t: The seed on good soil bears fruit
x: But that having been sown on the good soil, this is the one hearing the word and understanding, who indeed bears fruit and produces—some indeed a hundredfold, and some sixty, and some thirty.”

days.t: An honest and good heart holds the word fast
x: And the [seed] in the good soil, these are those [who], in a beautiful and good heart, having heard the word, hold [it] fast and bear fruit in perseverance.
For thus saith the Lord to the men of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Break up fresh ground for yourselves, and sow not among thorns.

days.t: Keep your heart with the utmost care
x: Keep thine heart with the utmost care; for out of these are the issues of life.

days.t: Receive with meekness the implanted word
x: Therefore, having put off all filthiness and abundance of wickedness, accept in meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your⁺ souls.
